title: S9 Automation Registry
purpose: Machine-readable registry spine for governed automation assets that can affect governed BIM information.
governance_rules: Automation that writes or modifies governed information must be registered before production use.
Registry entries must be updated when version, scope, owner, approval state, or risk classification changes.
Unregistered automation that affects governed information is prohibited in production environments.
Automation changes that affect logic, scope, target data, or write behavior require governed change control and registry update.
Required execution evidence must be produced and retained where specified by the registry entry.

provenance.migration_note: Source-defined governance scaffold migrated without inventing production automation entries. The registry structure is machine-readable, but approval states and concrete automation assets remain intentionally unpopulated until governed review.
